author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This QuickBooks Online tutorial walks you through how to pay bills, set up vendors, and run a real accounts payable workflow.
💵 50% off QuickBooks Online ➜ https://quickbooks.kevinstratvert.com/ 

First, you'll see three ways to get a bill into QuickBooks, including forwarding an emailed invoice to your QuickBooks address and watching the system extract the vendor, date, and line items for you. 

Next, you'll set up Bill Pay and schedule your first ACH or paper check payment directly from a bill, with Intuit handling the transfer and the bank feed auto-matching the payment for you. 

Then, you'll set up a vendor properly, with 1099 tracking, payment terms, and a default expense category that QuickBooks reuses on every future bill. 

Afterward, you'll pay multiple bills at once on the Pay Bills screen, which is what turns one-off payments into a true accounts payable process you run on a schedule.

title: QuickBooks Online 2026: How to Pay Bills (Accounts Payable)
